operations.content: Soham reads in plain Windows terminal: always format structured output as ASCII box tables (+--+ borders, | pipes, = under header), full width, short phrases per cell, split by topic. Verify every table with a script width-check (all lines equal length) before sending, because broken tables cost trust.

Every agent gets its own keys/tokens/logins; never copy secrets between Hermes and Neocoder. Verify claims with live tool output before stating them; verify-first beats assuming. When giving Neocoder work, send end-goals-only prompts (what + proof), never step-by-step instructions.
